items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: So the colonel called me in and says, Mc, he says, I got a call and I'm supposed to bring you over to Group Headquarters... And he says..oh, I had gotten busted again in Paris!

ctx.x: got a call one morning after I came off this patrol. I just came off the patrol and the colonel wanted to see me. I had put in before that that I wanted to go into Special Service and play the cornet again.

So the colonel called me in and says, Mc, he says, I got a call and I'm supposed to bring you over to Group Headquarters, 115th Group Headquarters for AAA automatic weapons. And we had those four 50-calibers mounted on the half tracks. And he says..oh, I had gotten busted again in Paris! (LAUGHTER). That's what happened. I had gotten busted again in Paris. Drinking too much of that brandy and you know, and cognac, cognac and champagne.

So I got busted there in Paris and I was a private again. But he says you don't have to go. He says, it's up to you if you want to go and play with the band there in Special Service or I'll make you a sergeant again. (LAUGHTER). I said, no sir. I don't want to be anything anymore colonel. I just want to blow that horn again. (LAUGHTER). I'll be very happy to blow that horn.
